title: Darker Command Blocks
description: A resource pack that darkens the appearance of command blocks.
body:
This is a basic resource pack that darkens the appearance of command blocks in-game. I found it quite the surprise that this doesn't exist - and here it is.

Types of releases will be represented like this:
- Alpha: Not to be used, but you could try playing with it.
- Beta: Usable, but not recommended.
- Release: Recommended for everyone.
